{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q022_colg_crya_remote_homology","answer":"In SCOPe 2.04 the two domains were not treated as homologs: ColG CBD3b from 1nqd, chain A d1nqda_ and chain B d1nqdb_, was classified as family b.23.2.1, Collagen-binding domain, inside the CUB-like fold b.23, whereas the Cry3A domain-III/C-terminal beta-sandwich from 1dlc, d1dlca1 for A:500-644, was family b.18.1.3, delta-Endotoxin C-terminal domain, inside the Galactose-binding domain-like fold/superfamily b.18.1. Their lowest common SCOPe node was only class b, All beta proteins, so SCOPe 2.04 implied no specific evolutionary relationship. In the current public SCOPe release, 2.08, the ColG domain has been reclassified as b.18.1.36: it is still its own Collagen-binding domain family, but it now sits in fold b.18 and superfamily b.18.1, Galactose-binding domain-like, the same superfamily that contains Cry3A d1dlca1 in the separate delta-endotoxin C-terminal family b.18.1.3. The change is therefore from same class only to same superfamily, i.e. probable remote common ancestry, not merely a shared all-beta architecture and not same-family equivalence. The structural evidence behind that assignment is the shared galactose-binding-domain-like beta-sandwich/jelly-roll core; the functional evidence is weaker but coherent with the fold’s ligand-binding role, because 1nqd is a Clostridium histolyticum ColG collagen-binding module and 1dlc A:500-644 is the receptor/ligand-binding C-terminal domain of Bacillus thuringiensis Cry3A. Function should be transferred only at that broad extracellular binding-module level: collagen binding, Cry receptor specificity, insecticidal activity, and ColG collagenase catalysis are family- or other-domain properties and should not be inferred across b.18.1.3 and b.18.1.36. For representative use, 1nqd chains A and B are duplicate structures of the same Clostridium family member; in 2.08 chain A remains d1nqda_, while chain B’s biological CBD is d1nqdb1 A-equivalent residues 893-1008 plus a tiny l.1.1.1 fragment for residues 891-892, so d1nqda_ is the cleaner single representative for this comparison.","evidence_used":["pretrained model knowledge for structural and functional interpretation of ColG CBD3b and Cry3A domain III","mcp__scope.get_scop_service_info: /api/v1/, /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope.get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/2.04/pdb/1nqd, /api/v1/releases/2.04/pdb/1nqd/domains, /api/v1/releases/2.04/pdb/1dlc, /api/v1/releases/2.04/pdb/1dlc/domains, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1nqd, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1nqd/domains, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dlc, /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1dlc/domains","mcp__scope.compare_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1nqda_, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1nqda_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1nqda_/annotations, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1nqda_/homology, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1dlca1, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1dlca1/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1dlca1/annotations, /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1dlca1/homology, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1nqda_, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1nqda_/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1nqda_/annotations, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1nqda_/homology, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dlca1, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dlca1/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dlca1/annotations, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dlca1/homology","mcp__scope.list_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/domains?limit=10&sccs_prefix=b.18.1.36, /api/v1/releases/2.08/domains?limit=10&sccs_prefix=b.18.1.3"]}]}
